parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Helpline: Hello, this is Medical Help Direct. How can I help you?

Robert: Oh hello, I've got a problem with my back, with it being the middle of the night I can't go to the doctor. And I wonder if you can give me some advice.

Helpline: Certainly. But first, can I have your telephone number please?

Robert: It's 03786-439251.

Helpline: Okay. And if you could give me your first name, please.

Robert: Robert.

Helpline: And your surname?

Robert: Ridyard. That's R-I-D-Y-A-R-D.

Helpline: And now your address please.

Robert: It's 27 Station Road.

Helpline: Okay.

Robert: Moortown.

Helpline: And you need the postcode?

Robert: Yes please.

Robert: DP17 5HJ.

Helpline: And your date of birth?

Robert: The 25th of February, 1975.

Helpline: Fine. Now I just need to take details of your doctor.

Robert: She's called Dr. Craven.

Helpline: And the surgery?

Robert: It's Moortown Health Centre.

Helpline: Thanks. Now can you tell me a bit more about what the problem is?

Robert: Well, like I said, it's my back.

Helpline: Okay. Can you tell me which part of the back?

Robert: Lower.

Helpline: And have you had any problems with your back before?

Robert: Yes. I had a bit of trouble last year in June, I think. Or was it July? No,I went on holiday at the beginning of July and it had cleared up by then.

Helpline: And when did it start this time? Has it just come on?

Robert: No, I've had it, let's see, since Monday so that's three days now. But it wasn't too bad at first. I mean I could just about get around though. I couldn't drive the car or anything. Then this afternoon the pain suddenly got so bad that I... I've been in bed since, but that hasn't helped.

Helpline: And do you have any pain elsewhere, in your stomach or abdomen for example?

Robert: No.

Helpline: Okay. Now have you any idea what caused the problem?

Robert: Well I was tidying up my office and I lifted a box up from the floor that was heavier than I thought. And I think that's what did it.

Helpline: Yes it's easily done isn't it? So you're in bed now.

Robert: Yes.

Helpline: Have you tried applying heat to the back?

Robert: Yes, I've got a hot water bottle. That's usually the first thing I try.

Helpline: And have you taken any painkillers?

Robert: Yes.

Helpline: And other than that, you feel quite well?

Robert: I do yes.

Helpline: Right. Now I can't diagnose or prescribe any medication but I can offer you some advice. One thing you could do now is to see if ice makes any difference. That sometimes helps. But don't put it directly onto your skin. Wrap it up in a towel or something. And don't leave it on for longer than 20 minutes.

Robert: Oh right. I haven't tried that before.

Helpline: It can be useful sometimes. Now have you seen your doctor about this?

Robert: No. I just thought well everyone has back pain. But I've never had it as bad as this before.

Helpline: I think you should go and see your doctor tomorrow. And she may be able to give you something to help.

Robert: Okay I'll do that. I'm actually feeling a bit better now.

Helpline: Good. And you might get some advice from her about exercise. That's often the best way of dealing with this sort of problem.

Robert: Okay I'll ask her.

Helpline: Right. Now, if you're worried about anything before tomorrow, you can always phone back. Our lines are open 24 hours.

Robert: Thanks very much.

analyses.content: Robert 逐个字母拼出了他的姓氏：R-I-D-Y-A-R-D。
Helpline: And your surname? Robert: Ridyard. That's R-I-D-Y-A-R-D.
这种题纯粹考拼写速度，千万别把 'R' 听成 'A' 或者漏掉中间的字母。
Helpline: And now your address please. Robert: It's 27 Station Road.
切记不要重复填数字！ 如果填了 "27 Station Road"，卷面就会变成 "27 27 Station Road"，这在雅思评分中是必错的。
Robert 报出的地址是 "27 Station Road"，因为卷面上已经印好了门牌号 "27"，你只需要填后面的路名 Station Road。
Helpline: And your date of birth? Robert: The 25th of February, 1975.
年份（1975）通常不需要填，因为题目已经暗示了是填写“月和日”，或者受限于字数限制。
Robert 说的出生日期是 25th of February。
Helpline: Can you tell me which part of the back? Robert: Lower.
题目已经有了 "back"，所以你只需要填修饰词 "lower"，不要重复填 "lower back"。
接线员问是背部哪里疼，Robert 回答是 Lower（下背部）。
Robert: No, I've had it, let's see, since Monday so that's three days now.
题目问的是 "Started ... ago"（多久以前开始的），所以要填时间段（3 days），而不能填时间点（Monday）。
Robert 说他从周一就开始疼了，算下来已经是 3 days（三天了）。
Robert 提到今天**afternoon（下午）**疼痛突然加剧了。
But it wasn't too bad at first... Then this afternoon the pain suddenly got so bad that I...
要注意区分时间点，刚开始（at first）不太痛，变糟糕（got worse）是在下午。
Robert: Well I was tidying up my office and I lifted a box up from the floor that was heavier than I thought.
题目中已有形容词 "heavy"，你需要填被修饰的名词 "box"。
Robert 认为受伤的原因是他搬起了一个比想象中更重的 box（箱子/盒子）。
Helpline: And have you taken any painkillers? Robert: Yes.
上一句刚讨论完 "hot water bottle"（热敷），那是上一行的答案，别填串行了。
接线员问有没有吃 painkillers（止痛药），Robert 回答吃过了。
One thing you could do now is to see if ice makes any difference. That sometimes helps. But don't put it directly onto your skin. Wrap it up in a towel or something.
后面提到的 "towel"（毛巾）是用来包裹冰块的工具，不是治疗方法本身。
接线员建议现在可以尝试用 ice（冰/冰敷） 看看有没有效果。
Helpline: Good. And you might get some advice from her about exercise. That's often the best way of dealing with this sort of problem.
接线员先说了自己不能 "diagnose or prescribe"，所以这些都不是你要填的建议内容，真正的建议在最后。
接线员建议 Robert 明天看医生时，咨询关于 exercise（运动/锻炼） 的建议。
